capabilityGroups.title: Connector catalog coverage
capabilityGroups.focus: Which enterprise systems are supported as synced or indexed connectors.
capabilityGroups.rationale: Answers whether Microsoft covers required source systems for enterprise rollout.

capabilityGroups.title: Ingestion and freshness
capabilityGroups.focus: Full crawl, incremental sync, event freshness, first crawl, permission freshness.
capabilityGroups.rationale: Indexed content is only useful if it is current and complete.

capabilityGroups.title: Permissions and security model
capabilityGroups.focus: ACLs, identity sync, external groups, deny-aware access, permission trimming.
capabilityGroups.rationale: Synced connectors must preserve source permissions after indexing.

capabilityGroups.title: Setup and configuration
capabilityGroups.focus: Auth model, inclusion rules, schema controls, staged rollout, setup friction.
capabilityGroups.rationale: Determines whether large tenants can deploy connectors consistently.

capabilityGroups.title: Observe and manage
capabilityGroups.focus: State, crawl stats, item errors, index browser, usage, edit or pause controls.
capabilityGroups.rationale: Admins need operational confidence after deployment, not just successful setup.
